Title: Manoj and the Family

Cast

1. Manoj - 35 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Neeta - 32 years, daughter
Look: green saree
3. Vinod - 58 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Nitin - 36 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt
5. Pallavi - 64 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The terrace - Day

[Neeta stands on the terrace. Manoj and Pallavi stand near her.]

Manoj: "Let's do something fun today."

[Neeta hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Neeta: "One more time!"

[Manoj falls from the ladder and hurts his leg.]

Pallavi (surprised): "Neeta, look at this."

[Manoj falls from the roof and dies.]

Pallavi (softly): "Rest in peace."
